title: ☀️ Daily Sunwatch Update — SDO Images Restored!
text:
After being unavailable since September 21, NASA's Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO) imagery is back online!

Sunny has resumed his normal mix of NASA SDO and NOAA GOES SUVI imagery for his daily solar observations.

Welcome back, SDO! ☀️♥️
